name: Eunuch
overview: Scripture presents eunuchs as individuals who, despite physical limitations or voluntary choices, are included in God's covenant community when they faithfully keep His commandments and choose what pleases Him, as Isaiah affirms God's promise of an everlasting name to such eunuchs. While Deuteronomy restricts those physically maimed from entering the congregation, Isaiah offers hope and honor to eunuchs who serve the Lord. Additionally, eunuchs held influential positions in royal courts, exemplified by Ebedmelech, an Ethiopian eunuch who courageously intervened on behalf of Jeremiah, demonstrating their significant roles within God's providential plan.
